{{Quote|We will do all we can to protect our assets and intellectual properties.|[[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]]|<ref name="HNN48">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|business/13321_1.html|Corporate Alliance Attacks Slicer Compound}}</ref>}}
The '''Corporate Alliance''' was one of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] commerce guilds. It was the negotiating body for several of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] largest commercial firms. Headquartered in [[Murkhana City/Legends|Murkhana City]], [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]], its members wielded large financial and economical influence, making the Corporate Alliance a wealthy and influential member of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Members and consumers alike were encouraged to identify with the Alliance in a near-religious way.

After Magistrate [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] was [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|killed on Mustafar]], the Alliance was dissolved and [[Imperialization/Legends|imperialized]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following its [[Declaration of a New Order|founding]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

==History==
{{Quote|The Corporate Alliance controls everything!|[[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]|<ref name="Corruption">{{TCW|Corruption (episode)}}</ref>}}
[[File:Passel_Denaria.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] of the Corporate Alliance, and [[Denaria Kee/Legends|Denaria Kee]]]]
During the last days of the Galactic Republic, the Corporate Alliance was represented in the Senate by [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the chairman of its largest member company, [[Lethe Merchandising]]. In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], they were engaged in a mineral-rights dispute with the [[Brolf]]i on [[Barlok/Legends|Barlok]].

Like its contemporaries, the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], the Corporate Alliance maintained its own security forces to defend its interests, and like the Trade Federation, it was ruled by a [[Corporate Alliance Directorate|directorate]]. Originally, its forces were used to enforce its expansionistic and often unfair business practices on [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] worlds. This is what spurred the development of weapons such as the [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 ''Persuader''-class droid enforcer]]. Over time, the Corporate Alliance grew frustrated with the Senate's limitations on its actions. It supported the Trade Federation's [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion of Naboo]], and eventually aligned itself with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] emerging [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] movement with the promise of unlimited profit under a new government. The Corporate Alliance would remain a silent supporter of the Separatists and regulated the distribution of retail products in favor of the Confederacy.

During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the Alliance took an increasingly aggressive stance against organizations it perceived as a threat. [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 ''Persuader''-class droid enforcers]] [[Raid on Yirt-4138-Grek-12|attacked]] a [[Yirt-4138-Grek-12 slicer compound|slicer compound]] in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] after Alliance clerk [[Denlace Sachoore]], based on an [[Yirt-4138-Grek-12|asteroid]] in that area, was found embezzling data. Twenty-five cybernetic data thieves were killed in the assault, though Alliance executives continued to demonstrate that the actions of the tank droids fell within legal boundaries.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Corporate Alliance pledged its security forces to the military of the Confederacy, most notably its deadly ''Persuader''-class droid enforcers, while Alliance [[Fantail-class destroyer/Legends|''Fantail''-class destroyers]] joined the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]]. Heavy units, including artillery droids, supplied by the Corporate Alliance were used across the galaxy, from [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] to [[Sarapin/Legends|Sarapin]]. Magistrate Argente, leader of the Alliance, took personal command of [[Merai]]'s forces during the [[First Battle of Kamino]], though the assault on [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] ended in failure. The Corporate Alliance also funded and marketed both anti-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and anti-Republic propaganda which helped keep the public in Confederate territory pro-war. Following the deaths of Argente and his chief aide [[Denaria Kee/Legends|Denaria Kee]] during the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|Mission to Mustafar]], as well as the [[Battle of Murkhana (Clone Wars)|assault]] on their headquarters at Murkhana, the Corporate Alliance faded into oblivion and its remaining assets were absorbed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Those that remained independent of the growing Imperial military-industrial complex sought refuge with the like-minded [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], and were eventually absorbed into the organization.

==Behind the scenes==
The Corporate Alliance has several real-world parallels, notably the Canadian Industrial Alliance and a company called the Corporate Alliance that acts as a negotiating body for many real-world companies.
